summary: Tiered CI policy config (small/medium/large cost classes), validator, and selection helper combining path map, PR kind caps, and force-run rules for workflow/map/test changes. Does not wire plate workflows yet.
migration_impact: Optional: adopters copy ci-policy.example.yml, classify job_sizes from gh plate ci audit, and call select_tiered_ci_jobs before gating optional jobs. Required checks labels, test, and pr-gates unchanged until a follow-up PR wires workflows.
migration_guidance: 1. Keep ci-path-jobs.yml enabled with all optional job ids.
2. Copy .agentic/ci-policy.example.yml to .agentic/ci-policy.yml; set enabled: true and job_sizes from measured runs.
3. Pass --pr-kind ordinary or release_patch|release_minor|release_major from Release metadata; use nightly for scheduled full suite.
4. Wire select_tiered_ci_jobs in CI only after owner approval; keep aggregate test job pattern from ci-path-job-selection.md.
agent_notes: Regression: tests/test_ci_tiered_policy.py. Policy doc notes out-of-scope workflow changes (#1332 scope split).
